list_channels.title: List channels
list_channels.description: List the workspace's messaging channels (SMS, WhatsApp, email and others) with their ids, platform and status. Channel ids are needed by every send and message-listing tool.

page_token.description: nextPageToken from the previous page. Keep paging while a nextPageToken is returned.

output.description: Channels in results, plus nextPageToken when more exist.

get_channel.title: Get a channel
get_channel.description: Get one channel's details: platform, name, status and identifiers such as the sending phone number.

send_message.title: Send a text message on a channel
send_message.description: Send a plain-text message through a channel (SMS, WhatsApp, etc.) to one or more recipients identified by phone number or email. Returns the message with its id and status. For WhatsApp outside the 24-hour window use send_template_message; to reply inside a conversation thread use send_conversation_message.

channel_id.description: Id of the channel to send through.

to.description: Recipient identifiers: E.164 phone numbers (e.g. +31612345678) or email addresses.

output.description: The accepted message with id and status.

send_template_message.title: Send a template message on a channel
send_template_message.description: Send an approved template (e.g. a WhatsApp template) through a channel to one or more recipients, filling its variables. Use send_message for free text.

channel_id.description: Id of the channel to send through.

to.description: Recipient identifiers: E.164 phone numbers or email addresses.

project_id.description: Id of the template project (Bird addresses templates by project id, not name).

locale.description: Template locale, e.g. en, en-US, el.

output.description: The accepted message with id and status.

list_channel_messages.title: List channel messages
list_channel_messages.description: List messages sent or received on a channel, filtered by status and a time window (at most 7 days). Use to check delivery status of recent sends; get_channel_message fetches one.

page_token.description: nextPageToken from the previous page. Keep paging while a nextPageToken is returned.

end_at.description: Window end, ISO 8601 UTC; no more than 7 days after start_at.

output.description: Messages in results, plus nextPageToken when more exist.

get_channel_message.title: Get a channel message
get_channel_message.description: Get one message sent or received on a channel, including its body, recipients, status and failure reason if any.

list_message_interactions.title: List message interactions
list_message_interactions.description: List the interactions recorded for a sent message, such as delivery receipts, reads, clicks and reactions, in time order.

output.description: Interactions in results, plus nextPageToken when more exist.

get_channel_conversations_config.title: Get channel conversations setting
get_channel_conversations_config.description: Check whether conversations are enabled on a channel, i.e. whether incoming messages start conversations. Returns status active or inactive.

set_channel_conversations_config.title: Enable or disable channel conversations
set_channel_conversations_config.description: Turn conversations on (active) or off (inactive) for a channel. Must be active for incoming messages to start conversations and for the conversation tools to see them.

list_conversations.title: List conversations
list_conversations.description: List the workspace's conversations (threads of messages between contacts and your channels), most recent first.

page_token.description: nextPageToken from the previous page. Keep paging while a nextPageToken is returned.

output.description: Conversations in results, plus nextPageToken when more exist.

get_conversation.title: Get a conversation
get_conversation.description: Get one conversation: its channel, participants, status, name and last message.

create_conversation.title: Create a conversation
create_conversation.description: Start a conversation on a channel with one contact identified by phone number or email, sending the initial message with it. Bird refuses empty conversations and returns 409 if one already exists with that contact; then use send_conversation_message on the existing conversation.

identifier_value.description: The contact's phone number (E.164) or email address.

update_conversation.title: Update a conversation
update_conversation.description: Rename a conversation or change its status, e.g. close it.

status.description: New status, e.g. active or closed.

delete_conversation.title: Delete a conversation
delete_conversation.description: Permanently delete a conversation. Use update_conversation to close it while keeping the history.

list_conversation_messages.title: List conversation messages
list_conversation_messages.description: List the messages in a conversation across channels, with sender, body and status.

page_token.description: nextPageToken from the previous page. Keep paging while a nextPageToken is returned.

output.description: Messages in results, plus nextPageToken when more exist.

get_conversation_message.title: Get a conversation message
get_conversation_message.description: Get one message in a conversation, including its full body and delivery status.

send_conversation_message.title: Send a text message in a conversation
send_conversation_message.description: Post a text reply into an existing conversation, sent as the given channel (participant type flow). Pass an idempotency_key so a retry does not deliver twice. For WhatsApp outside the 24-hour window use send_conversation_template_message.

channel_id.description: Channel id the reply is sent as.

output.description: The created message with id and status.

send_conversation_template_message.title: Send a template in a conversation
send_conversation_template_message.description: Send an approved template into an existing conversation to a named recipient, e.g. a WhatsApp template outside the 24-hour window.

channel_id.description: Channel id the message is sent as.

project_id.description: Id of the template project (Bird addresses templates by project id, not name).

locale.description: Template locale, e.g. en, en-US, el.

output.description: The created message with id and status.

delete_conversation_message.title: Delete a conversation message
delete_conversation_message.description: Delete one message from a conversation permanently; returns no content.
